key_requirements: Consent for collection & use, confidentiality of personal information, compensation for harm
penalties_range: Up to 3 years prison and/or NPR 30k fine
exemptions: Collection/use permitted for national security or peace and order; disclosure on legal demand for national security (section numbers not confirmed) (unconfirmed)
genetic_data: No explicit genetic category found; sensitive information (s.27(2)) covers caste, ethnicity, health; biometric data (incl. blood group) is personal information (unconfirmed)
notes: Also cited as Individual Privacy Act; Privacy Regulation 2020 supplements it
